nodes.label: mount-buller/README.md
nodes.rationale: Documents implementation, content decisions, design, licensing, task state, and browser verification for the independent Candoux 4 advertising website.

nodes.label: Keep the redesign on a separate branch
nodes.norm_label: keep the redesign on a separate branch

nodes.label: Candoux 4 Apartment
nodes.rationale: The supplied listing is the source for property facts, photographs, and the apartment-specific booking link; occupancy is represented consistently with the summary and bed arrangement, while final confirmation is left to AMS.

nodes.label: Browser Verification Script
nodes.rationale: The script covers viewport sizes, page scrolling, image loading, runtime errors, and FAQ states, and stores artifacts in ignored test-results.

nodes.label: Chrome for Testing
nodes.rationale: An isolated process with separate browser contexts is used for acceptance testing without personal credentials.

nodes.label: Graphify Indexing
nodes.rationale: Available structure, semantic documents, manifest, and portable HTML are retained despite indexing limitations that do not affect the application.

nodes.label: Liquid Glass Recommendation
nodes.rationale: The automatic recommendation was judged a poor fit and was not adopted.

nodes.label: Melbourne Visitor Origin
nodes.rationale: Melbourne is the visitor origin, not the apartment address.

nodes.label: Mount Buller Apartment Advertising Website
nodes.rationale: The website is an independent advertising site for Candoux 4 within lopugit/tmp.

nodes.label: NBN Comparison Branch
nodes.rationale: The branch is preserved alongside the independent apartment advertising website.

nodes.label: Nitro
nodes.rationale: Nitro packages the Vite dist directory as Vercel Build Output using an absolute public-assets path.

nodes.label: Fresh origin/master Base Commit
nodes.rationale: The repository has no main branch; the isolated worktree was based on freshly fetched origin/master.

nodes.label: Older Quasar App
nodes.rationale: The older app is preserved alongside the independent apartment advertising website.

nodes.label: RMS Booking Engine
nodes.rationale: Rates and availability are left to the real booking manager, and bookings are not processed locally.

nodes.label: Thingtime Private Reporting
nodes.rationale: Reporting was attempted under the stable task identity, but the connected account lacks the independent agents.report grant; no alternate identity or duplicate workspace was used.
